scientific_integrity: The result is an exact modal and local semilinear stability classification on a smooth Neumann disk. All nonlinear bifurcation branches, global basins and patterned attractors remain unproved. A critical first-mode eigenspace has spatial multiplicity two. The model-specific novelty is provisional against unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Local equilibrium stability/instability only, not global dynamics.
No branch existence or nonlinear fate at stationary or oscillatory thresholds.
Primary eigenvalues occur with multiplicity two due to disk rotational symmetry.
No general parameter-space classification, only one positive-parameter family and small perturbations.
title: Reentrant equilibrium stability between stationary and oscillatory spatial instabilities in a two-signal predator–prey system
